title: Vanity Fair and Olivia Nuzzi part ways amid scandal over RFK Jr relationship
summary: ‘Mutual’ decision follows controversy over relationship with presidential candidate and claims of ethical breaches Vanity Fair is ending its association with Olivia Nuzzi , who had briefly been the magazine’s west coast editor, as the publication distances itself from controversy tied in part to her relationship with US health secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr. “Vanity Fair and Olivia Nuzzi have mutually agreed, in the best interest of the magazine, to let her contract expire at the end of the year,” publisher Condé Nast said in a statement on Friday shared with the New York Times .
